source_text:
13.3 Καὶ ὁδὸν εἰρήνης οὐκ ε γνωσαν, οὐκ ε στι
φόβος Θεοῦ ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν. ̓Εγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς, φησὶν ὁ Σωτὴρ, καὶ
αὐτός ἐστιν εἰρήνη ἡμῶν. –Τῷ γὰρ φόβῳ Κυρίου ἐκκλίνει πᾶς ἀπὸ κακοῦ.
pass_a_gloss: And way of-peace not they-knew, not there-is fear of-God opposite of-the eyes of-them. I am the way, says the Savior, and himself is peace of-us. For by-the fear of-Lord turns-aside everyone from evil.
pass_b_english: “And they did not know the way of peace; there is no fear of God before their eyes” (Psalm 13:3).
“I am the way,” says the Savior, and he himself is our peace. For by the fear of the Lord everyone turns away from evil.

choices.term: οὐκ ἔστι φόβος Θεοῦ ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν
choices.english: there is no fear of God before their eyes
choices.why: οὐκ ἔστι negates the whole clause. OCR οὐκ ε στι. Not ‘Fear of God is before their eyes’.
rejected: Fear of God is before their eyes
there is no. Fear of God is before their eyes

choices.why: Aorist. OCR ε γνωσαν. Not present ‘they do not know’.
The Savior of the previous clause is our peace. Not a free-floating ‘peace is ours’.

choices.term: Τῷ γὰρ φόβῳ Κυρίου ἐκκλίνει πᾶς ἀπὸ κακοῦ
choices.english: For by the fear of the Lord everyone turns away from evil
choices.why: Explains why no fear of God is before their eyes: fear of the Lord is what turns a person from evil.
rejected: fear of the Lord is evil

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
